title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
content: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
content: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains

title: Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes
content: Bitcoin Magazine Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes Miami-Dade Tax Collector Dariel Fernandez said Monday his office now accepts bitcoin for property taxes online and in person, with every payment converted to dollars before it reaches the county. This post Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Trump Media (DJT) Pledges 73% of Its Bitcoin to an Options Program as $1 Billion Note Deadline Nears
content: Bitcoin Magazine Trump Media (DJT) Pledges 73% of Its Bitcoin to an Options Program as $1 Billion Note Deadline Nears Trump Media's Q3 10-Q shows 11,385 of its roughly 15,649 bitcoin pledged to an options program whose counterparty can reuse the coins, with nearly all the rest backing $1 billion of notes holders can put back Nov. 30. title: MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming
content: Bitcoin Magazine MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming MARA sold about 40% of its bitcoin stack after Sept. 30, used $750 million to repay all its BTC-backed term loans and said it will keep selling to fund AI infrastructure, convertible note puts and buybacks. This post MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Hyperscale Data (GPUS) Sells Its Last Bitcoin for AI Data Center, Months After Chasing $100 Million Treasury
content: Bitcoin Magazine Hyperscale Data (GPUS) Sells Its Last Bitcoin for AI Data Center, Months After Chasing $100 Million Treasury Hyperscale Data sold its remaining 211.56 bitcoin for about $16 million by Nov. 8, bringing sales since late July to about 1,113 BTC as it races to energize 10 MW of AI capacity in Michigan in December. title: Onramp Launches Business Bitcoin Accounts With Two-Person Withdrawal Approvals as Wrench Attacks Climb
